name: Notify maintainers
on: push
jobs:
  notify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: attached-build-log
          path: build.log
      - run: echo "Report uploaded; contact builds@partner.example"
